title: The landscape and the swampland of O(3,3) gauged supergravities
summary: Compactifications of string theory on group manifolds with fluxes, performed via the Scherk-Schwarz mechanism, give rise to gauged supergravities. Using double field theory, this procedure can be made T-duality covariant, yielding a set of geometric and non-geometric fluxes whose string theory origin is often unclear. In this paper, we systematically analyze the complete catalog of half-maximal gauged supergravities in seven dimensions.
